requirements.evidence: User requested a new 1.65 GHz rectangular patch antenna CST project for review, with no simulation.
requirements.pass_condition: Task type, output expectation, review-gated mode, frequency intent, and no-simulation instruction are recorded.
requirements.unchecked_risk: Antenna performance remains unchecked until simulation is allowed.

physical_structure.evidence: Structure brief records microstrip-fed rectangular patch on grounded dielectric substrate with radiation normal to top metal.
physical_structure.pass_condition: Layer stack, conductors, feed topology, propagation direction, and boundary meaning are recorded.
physical_structure.unchecked_risk: No field/current inspection because no solver was run.

parameterization.evidence: CST parameters and History entries define units, substrate height, patch dimensions, feed width, frequency range, and derived coordinates.
parameterization.pass_condition: Reusable dimensions are CST parameters before History commands reference them.
parameterization.unchecked_risk: Manual edits after validation require rerunning this ledger.

materials.evidence: CST material list contains dielectric substrate material and conductor material used by expected solids.
materials.pass_condition: Dielectric, conductor, and background material assignments match the structure brief.
materials.unchecked_risk: Material loss impact is not quantified without simulation.

geometry_connectivity.evidence: Geometry inventory shows substrate, continuous ground, patch metal, inset region, and feed line with intended contact to patch.
geometry_connectivity.pass_condition: Expected solids exist; signal path continuity, ground continuity, layer heights, and intended clearances are recorded.
geometry_connectivity.unchecked_risk: No meshed contact or current-flow evidence because no solver was run.

port.evidence: Port record declares waveguide Port on the feed transverse cross-section, spanning signal conductor, substrate, reference ground, and air with signal-to-ground mode line.
port.pass_condition: Microstrip distributed feed uses waveguide Port on full transverse line cross-section with reference ground and mode line.
port.unchecked_risk: No port-mode solve; modal impedance and field quality are unchecked.

boundary_background.evidence: Boundary setup and background/airbox plan are recorded for radiating antenna review.
boundary_background.pass_condition: Boundaries and background match antenna radiation physics and do not replace the feed cross-section check.
boundary_background.unchecked_risk: Open boundary/PML performance is not verified without solver messages.

solver_mesh_monitors.evidence: Frequency range and solver/mesh intent are recorded, with solver not started.
solver_mesh_monitors.pass_condition: Solver and mesh intent are declared without claiming solved performance.
solver_mesh_monitors.unchecked_risk: no solver run; no port-mode solve; no S-parameter/farfield/gain/efficiency conclusion

history.evidence: Persisted Model/3D/ModelHistory.json contains visible captions for parameters, material setup, geometry, port setup, boundaries, and frequency setup.
history.pass_condition: History entries are visible, specific, and persisted for user review.
history.unchecked_risk: GUI visual inspection can still reveal presentation issues not visible in JSON.

save_and_simulation_state.evidence: Project saved as a review copy and result tree checked for absence of solved S-parameter or farfield results.
save_and_simulation_state.pass_condition: Save path, copy policy, close policy, and no-simulation state are recorded.
save_and_simulation_state.unchecked_risk: project saved for review; no solver run; no port-mode solve; no S-parameter results

delivery.evidence: Final review package includes project path, design version, gate ledger, port record, assumptions, and unchecked risks.
delivery.pass_condition: The delivery does not claim antenna performance and names the next allowed action.
delivery.unchecked_risk: User review and optional simulation remain future steps.
